areas.description: The areas a task may be in, the values of the area property.

intent.description: The intent of the turn a message starts on a task with no live session.

contexts.description: The contexts the menu offers; a task may hold others.

owed_by.description: Who owes a task's next step.

expr.description: An expression over the task's facts whose value, me or a person's key, is task.owed_by.

additionalProperties.description: A property, by its name. A user layer may set only some keys of an entry declared below it; a new entry sets the required ones.

doc.description: What the property holds, for the facts' reference and the agents.

type.description: The property's type; required for a new property. An int or a duration of 0 means unset: a value of 0 is refused.

values.description: An enum's values, in order; required with type enum.

writers.description: Who may write the property; one an agent or a plugin may write is untrusted, so no approval rule reads it.

props.description: The task properties, by name, in the order the file declares them, a user layer's new ones after the bundled; each is the fact task.prop.<name>, typed from its type.

stale_waiting_days.description: Working days a task waits before it is stale.

additionalProperties.description: A state, by its name. A user layer may set only some keys of an entry declared below it; a new entry sets the required ones.

category.description: The state's category, which is all Go reads of it; required for a new state.

states.description: The states a task takes, by name, in the order the file declares them, a user layer's new ones after the bundled; clients list them in this order, and a task proposed in a category takes the first state of it.

additionalProperties.description: A verb, by its name. A user layer may set only some keys of an entry declared below it; a new entry sets the required ones.

A predicate over the task's facts that lets the actor run the verb where it holds, or "gate", which opens the gate the verb's gate names, and a person's approval runs the verb as theirs; true lets the actor run it anywhere.

by.description: Who may run the verb, by actor (person, workflow, agent, plugin); an actor left out may not.

from.description: The states the verb moves a task from, each a state of states; every state when absent.

gate.description: The gate, of gates.toml, a by.<actor> of "gate" opens; required when one does.

handler.description: What the verb runs besides its move, a handler of the loop's; none when absent.

input.description: The question a verb that asks for a value puts first (waiting, schedule, project, context, area, delegate, reply); required for those.

label.description: The name people read on its button. Required.

offer.description: When a task offers the verb, over the task's own facts (task.id, task.prop.kind, task.state, task.muted, task.unit, task.unit_provider); where it holds not, the verb is neither listed nor run.

send.description: On a verb whose handler is reply: what a reply that names no send does. now sends it at once, as the person approving it; draft holds it on its gate for approval. The composer's Save as draft always holds it.

summary.description: One line, what pressing it does: its tooltip. Required.

to.description: The state the verb moves a task to, a state of states; absent, the verb moves none.

verbs.description: The verbs a task offers, by verb.
